name: cadence
description: AI social media manager that runs on your computer. Paste a website: it learns the brand, plans a month of posts, and publishes after you approve. Node.js server + SQLite + Playwright visuals, official APIs for 12 platforms (Instagram, LinkedIn, X, TikTok...). Uses Claude Code, Codex, Gemini CLI or any OpenAI-compatible model.

paragraphs: Your brand, on beat. A local-first social media agent that runs on your own AI agent.

Paste a client's website. Cadence extracts the brand's design system, plans a month of posts with platform-specific copy and branded visuals, puts everything in an approval inbox, and publishes through official APIs once you approve. Everything runs on your machine. The writing is done by the AI agent you already use.
features: Brand from a URL. Extracts colors, type, voice and audience, saves a reusable brand system, and judges a rendered sample against it.
Month plan. Content pillars, a posting rhythm and per-platform copy, with Playwright-rendered visuals (editorial, carousel, square).
Approval inbox. Preview, edit per platform, comment, regenerate from feedback, approve and schedule in one click. Nothing is published without approval unless you turn the autonomy dial up.
Twelve platforms. Instagram, Facebook, LinkedIn, X, Threads, Bluesky, Mastodon, Pinterest, TikTok, Reddit, Telegram, Discord.
Bring your own agent. Claude Code, Codex, Gemini CLI, opencode, or any OpenAI-compatible endpoint.

whatItDoes.text: Your brand, on beat. A local-first social media agent that runs on your own AI agent.

requirements.text: Without a browser opener (xdg-open), npm run open prints the sign-in link instead.
Instagram, Facebook, Threads and TikTok sign-in also needs openssl (Git for Windows includes it, or winget install ShiningLight.OpenSSL.Light).
